integrity: Symbolic proof of global all-path statements is supported by exact Erlang-tail identities; standalone checker compares 336 infected-subset CTMC cases and 950 sampled inequalities. Numerical tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous continuous-time SI on finite paths, a uniformly chosen single seed, no recovery, perfect immediate monitoring of exactly two fixed vertices. The general early-versus-late reversal does not classify every intermediate deadline on longer paths. A 2017 SI temporal-network surveillance paper was inspected at abstract/excerpt level only. Equivalent unpublished or older network reliability results remain possible.
title: A universal deadline reversal for two sentinels on epidemic paths
